applied_settings: KIT VERIFICATION RUN - NOT USABLE AS DATA. The operator was actively using the machine throughout (Opera, Discord, Spotify open, interactive work in progress), which by this project's own 2026-08-22 finding depresses measured throughput by up to 6% in the 1237-2010 MHz band and inflates run-to-run spread roughly fivefold. Do not compare these numbers against any other sweep. Purpose is to prove the resynced collection kit runs end to end. CONFIG: original tune, declared by the operator and confirmed against the Afterburner curve editor - memory +2500 MHz offset (expect 16301 under load against the 14001 rating), core V/F curve pinned flat at ~3010 MHz from ~925 mV upward, raised above stock below that (~1900 MHz at 700 mV where stock is ~1400), step at ~845-850 mV. NOT the split curve. Power limit 200W. Instant Replay OFF, encoder 0% and decoder 0% over 10 samples before start.
